svg.text: c.1660 English manor, hall-and-cross-wings (H-plan). North at top.

holo-emitter - overhead plan. APPROVED 2026-08-21; DERIVED from fixtures/demo-study/plan.json. Content the sheet does not draw has changed since then (sha 0987ac56); the drawing is unaffected. AWAITING HIS EYE ON: the standpoint distances on 38 of the manor's 88 facings, changed since the sheet he approved. Drawn at 26 px per metre; use the
scale bar. All room dimensions are clear internal metres.
o standpoint for one facing; the dashed leader runs to the wall
line that facing views. The printed number IS camera_wall_m.
N 4.35 = facing N, standpoint 4.35 m from the N wall line.
"open" = no facing wall; the number is to the drawn far ground line.
Doubled red arrows = an opening, with the travel directions
through it. You arrive facing the way you went (orientation law).
LAW (a) - every facing's standpoint is marked, with its measured distance to the wall line it views. camera_wall_m is READ OFF THIS DRAWING, never invented.

LAW (b) - outdoor walls exist ONLY where the manor's exterior wall stands. The heavy black outline is the single source of every outdoor wall; the privy garden wall is the one further BUILT structure and is drawn as one.

★ door1 - the existing M0 exit. STUDY east wall <-> CROSS PASSAGE west wall, which is world.json's 'hall'. Blueprint 11's study wall map holds as drawn: fireplace N, door E, leaded windows S, blank paneling W.

Blueprint 11's hall wall map holds too - shelf/paneling N, tapestry S, leaded window at the E end - but the manor gives the passage two further openings (N to the buttery, S to the kitchen) that map does not draw. Flagged for Kabe in the README.

Every interior opening on this sheet joins the two spaces it names, and every space is reachable on foot from the ENTRANCE APPROACH - checked by tools/validate-plan.mjs, both floors, stairs included, which also refuses to let this sheet be drawn from a plan that fails.
